goal: Wave 1 build: Shared turn record; Serialised per-org chained insert; Signed baseline, candidate and rehearsal (code half)

slices.title: Shared turn record
slices.summary: Mirrors the turn-to-run identifiers into a best-effort Redis record (ids only, identity-scoped key, 24 h TTL) so feedback sent to another replica resolves a turn that streamed elsewhere. PreviousTurnRegistry stays local, and the mirror reuses the stream-buffer breaker.
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_SHARED_TURN_RECORD (default off; flipped on in S9)

slices.title: Serialised per-org chained insert
slices.summary: Chains new audit rows per org inside insertAudit: a head row locked FOR UPDATE, with chain_seq, prev_hash and row_hash written in the same transaction, plus a guard trigger on UPDATE and DELETE, a boot catch-up for rows before activation (chain_mode catchup), and the chain metrics. Off by default behind AUDIT_CHAIN_ENABLED; rows before activation stay legacy_unchained with no backfill.
test_commands: cd "apps/Control Plane/audit-core" && TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres:t@localhost:55432/postgres?sslmode=disable" go vet ./... && go test ./...
slices.notes: Do NOT edit these shared files (the lead applies your exact lines after the batch; put them in lead_todo as 'shared-edit <file>: <exact lines>'): apps/Control Plane/docker-compose.yml

slices.title: Signed baseline, candidate and rehearsal (code half)
slices.summary: Operator release: a signing key ceremony, a signed baseline built from a clean detached worktree at the D12 revision in non-release mode, a signed candidate built in release mode, the S10 rehearsal, deploys of candidate, baseline and candidate, the cross-plane preflight and the conformance artifact, then the release evidence and status updates and a new rollback rehearsal runbook.
slices.remaining: Code half: Signing, verify and rehearsal pipeline exercised end to end with clearly labelled dev-only ephemeral keys (Q-7a2-02 default).

bash 'scripts/coresystem-conformance.sh' --profile runtime (must read ready on the clean candidate tree)
